s: Bei der Geschwindigkeit wirken immense Kräfte.
Immense forces act at this speed.
Man müsste eine Kraft einstellen, um diese ganzen Akten zu sortieren.
We should hire someone to organize all these files.
Kraft.et:
From Middle High German kraft, from Old High German kraft, from Proto-West Germanic *kraftu, from Proto-Germanic *kraftuz (strength, power).
Cognate with Dutch kracht, Low German Kracht, English craft, Danish kraft.

s: on the basis of; by virtue of; by means of, through
Im Bewusstsein seiner Verantwortung vor Gott und den Menschen […] hat sich das Deutsche Volk kraft seiner verfassungsgebenden Gewalt dieses Grundgesetz gegeben.
Conscious of its responsibility before God and men […] the German people has, in exercise of its constituent power, given itself this constitution.
Für Ballungsgebiete soll zunehmend die Abwärme aus Kraftwerken verwendet werden.
Kraftwerk.et: From Kraft (“power”) + Werk (“factory”). Cognate with Danish kraftværk, Norwegian and Swedish kraftverk.

s: bold, intense, powerful, robust, strong, sturdy, vigorous, vivid
kräftig.et: From Middle High German kreftic, kreftec, from Old High German kreftīg, from Proto-West Germanic *kraftīg, from Proto-Germanic *kraftugaz, equivalent to Kraft + -ig. Cognate with English crafty, Dutch krachtig.

s: power plant excitation equipment, power plant excitation system
